answer: The linemaker dyes his lines in the vat out back, and the dye must take even or the line is sold cheap. Tar manila hawser layer sisal licence is the dyeing: a licence manila hawser layers renew after laying yard audits. The signal is the first line dyed, the plume the last before the vat is emptied, and the mesa is the emptying, the vat scrubbed for tomorrow. A counterfeiter would dye 31 false lines and scrub 31 false vats.
